answer: To resist sybils, require each agent to stake a bonded deposit tied to a scarce, verifiable credential and post a small proof-of-work per epoch. Faking thousands of identities means paying that stake and compute repeatedly, so the cost scales linearly while rewards stay capped per verified identity. Honest nodes act as a lantern in a dark ocean of clones, flagging anomalies, and any attempt to forge a batch of fake identities burns real stake before it can vote. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
